description:
Get this workspace's Brand DNA: brand_name, brand_kind, overview,
tagline, offer, features, products, audience, palette, logos, plus
`checks`: what to fix before rendering (thin Brand DNA, a typed
accent the brand's own work does not use). Call right after
get_account; fix thin DNA first with update_brand_dna and
upload_product_screen, or ask the human for the site. Not Brand
Memory.
name: get_brand_dna
